annotation: assistant visual and text review; no independent human adjudication
sampling: First detected contents page when title matched, otherwise page 2; catalogue body start, one-third, two-thirds and end. El Salvador body start manually corrected to PDF 27. Exact frozen pages in corpus.json. Catalogue ranges are approximate and include some annexes.
scope: Section headings on selected pages; contents entries, table/box captions and labels, running headers and inline bold lead-ins are negatives. Unselected pages are unlabelled, never negatives.
test_status: Final test evaluated once after validation selection; no subsequent tuning
training_expansion: After initial validation, two additional visually reviewed pages per training report; candidates ranked by numbered/bold lines. No additional validation/test pages and no test scores consulted.
